title: Fanatics: Growing the Sports Economy - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 51]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: This is Jesse Pujji, and today we are breaking down Fanatics.
reader_summary.overview: This is Jesse Pujji, and today we are breaking down Fanatics. If you’ve recently bought sports apparel online, you interacted with Fanatics. They power the entire digital commerce experience for the NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL, and hundreds of other sports leagues around the world.

key_points.text: To break down Fanatics, I am joined by an early investor, Deven Parekh, from Insight Partners.
Deven has been an investor in Fanatics since 2011.
We cover Fanatics' unique vertically integrated commerce model, how they redefined their TAM, and how the company is aggressively entering NFTs, real money betting.
